scan_table_check.description:
Flags Script Includes whose API name is also used by another active Script Include. Which definition a caller gets is then undefined.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Duplicate Script Include Name".
scan_table_check.name: SN-SI-002: Duplicate Script Include API name
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Give each Script Include a unique name. With two active definitions of the same API name, which one callers get is undefined; rename or deactivate one of them.
scan_table_check.short_description: Another active Script Include has the same API name.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-SI-002: Duplicate Script Include API name
